Title: V:EKN.NU is updated with KMW and 10th Anniversary

Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

having had a problematic winter with very little motivation as well as
no internet access for over a month V:EKN.NU is finally back on track
with the release of the Kindred Most Wanted expansion.

All cards are added for both the 10th Anniversay set, Kindred Most
Wanted set as well as the promos that have been released and you can
now search all cards the same way as you could before, quickly, easily
and most importantly, very fast.

The Attributes and Requirements lists are not yet updated with the
latest terms (such as Trophy, Red List etc), so you cannot choose any
of these terms as of yet. This will be added within the next few days.

So head on over www.vekn.nu and click on the Search link and have a go.

Please report any errors you to the email address specified on the
site.

Archie

Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:
